spots.name: Carter Wen
spots.text: Roadwolves hit the toll cart at dawn. If you go east, keep to the road. Forest is where they wait.
dialogue: 'I used to run the east road twice a week. Then the toll cart came back with its wheels still turning and no horses.'
'The wolves are not all beasts. Their chief pays deserters in silver and lets them keep whatever they can carry.'

spots.name: Village Guard
spots.text: Hask Gravelteeth's camp lies far to the east, past the old watchtower road. Bring more than three blades.
dialogue: 'The watchtower bell rings when the wind is from the north. Last night it rang with no wind at all.'
'If you find a brass token in the mud, don't spend it. The old road wardens used those to open the sealed storehouse.'

spots.name: Freed Debtor
spots.text: A traveller keeps a folded contract hidden beneath his coat.
spots.companion_quest_text: A former inmate shows Bram a contract with fees compounded after release and a signature copied from a dead witness. Compare the clauses and testimony: some debts are real, but these transfers are not lawful proof of what the prisoners owe.

spots.name: Muster Clerk
spots.text: A clerk has hidden an order beneath the town's old levy register.
spots.companion_quest_text: Anselm recognises the seal on a muster order dated after the ceasefire. Compare its authority and date before accepting the clerk's claim that the soldiers volunteered.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which detail proves the order cannot be treated as a lawful volunteer muster?
options: The order bears a campaign seal
The order is dated after the ceasefire and lacks a renewed levy warrant
The ink is faded
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The order is dated after the ceasefire and lacks a renewed levy warrant
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dates and missing warrant establish that the unit was recalled without lawful authority.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The campaign seal alone does not establish authority after the ceasefire.

spots.name: The Far Marker
spots.text: A weathered fen boundary stone bears a cut Tomas recognises from childhood.
spots.companion_quest_text: Tomas recognises the marker and admits he left the settlement without saying goodbye. He asks to follow the old scout signs before deciding whether to return.

spots.name: Innkeeper Maud
spots.text: Rest your feet, captain. Beds are full of drovers tonight, but the stew is hot and the gossip is free.
dialogue: 'A warm bed buys a man one honest night. A good story buys the next three.'
'The drover in the corner lost his brother near the old tower. He says the stones whisper names after rain.'

spots.name: Drover
spots.text: Heard a purse was left in the old tower, north of here. Nobody dares go. The roads are not what they were.

spots.name: Chain Yard Witness
spots.text: A teamster has seen debtors marched toward a guarded work yard.
spots.companion_quest_text: The witness knows where the debtors are being held. Bram refuses to leave them behind. The evidence can support a public tribunal, a negotiated release that preserves the records, or the destruction of the false transfer papers before the company can use them again.

spots.name: Tracks That Turn Back
spots.text: A ferryman remembers the old scout trail where tracks turn back toward the fen.
spots.companion_quest_text: The tracks show that Tomas's family sheltered deserters, but do not prove Tomas took part. Reconstruct the route from the signs and separate observation from rumour.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which trail reading is supported by the physical evidence?
options: The family cart turned toward the reed shelter; Tomas's bootprints continue east alone
Every bootprint belongs to Tomas and proves he led the deserters
The broken marker proves the family attacked the patrol
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The family cart turned toward the reed shelter; Tomas's bootprints continue east alone
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The separate tracks support the account: the family sheltered people, while Tomas continued east alone.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The other conclusions assign actions or motives that the tracks cannot prove.

spots.name: Shopkeeper Oswin
spots.text: Blades, mail, charms and sigils, all honestly priced. And your company's kit can be sorted out right here at the counter.
dialogue: Oswin rubs a thumb over a scar in the counter. 'A rune is not a bauble. It remembers every hand that has carried it.'
'I can seat a rune safely, or draw one out without cracking the socket. A field swap is how good steel gets ruined.'
'Bring me three of the same mark for the Forge. Their grades need not match, but a well-trained rune gives the ritual a steadier chance.'

spots.name: Elder Hale
spots.text: House Dunmarrow held these roads for three hundred years. Torren, the keep is yours to rebuild. Start with the road to Eldrimar.

spots.name: Drill Sergeant
spots.text: A retired sergeant keeps a tally of the men who were ordered back to the yard.
spots.companion_quest_text: The drill tally lists men marked absent even when they were on approved leave. Anselm asks you to compare the muster column with the leave marks.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which record best confirms that the roll was falsified?
options: A matching leave mark beside a man recorded absent
A missing boot from the rack
A second copy of the same tally
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A matching leave mark beside a man recorded absent
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The approved leave marks contradict the absent entries and expose the false count.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A second copy may repeat the same error; it does not independently verify the men.

spots.name: The Homeward Hearing
spots.text: Elder Hale has received accusations against Tomas's family and asks for witnesses before the settlement acts.
spots.companion_quest_text: The settlement is divided. Tomas may return openly, help his family relocate or remain away and send aid. No choice makes him responsible for another person's decisions.

spots.name: Gate Warden
spots.text: The walls are cracked, but they hold. Steward Brannoch is waiting in the great hall.

spots.name: The Prisoner's Petition
spots.text: A guarded messenger brings a request from the commander Garrick once spared.
spots.companion_quest_text: The former commander has been accused of ordering reprisals after his release. He asks Garrick to hear him before the hearing. Garrick insists that the request be recorded, but that the witnesses must be heard independently.

spots.name: Steward Brannoch
spots.text: The road is open, my lord, but it is not safe. Train the company, forge sigils, and clear the Roadwolf Camp.
dialogue: 'Your house held this valley by oath, not by walls. Walls can be raised again; trust takes longer.'
'The quartermaster has sent word of a smith at the lower gate. He can temper any weapon or piece of armor to +15, though the price rises with every strike.'
'The old families kept heirloom runes apart from common stock. They are not merchandise. They choose their bearer.'

spots.name: War Table
spots.text: The war table: sort your company, gear, sigils and promotions here, or send for the market stock.
dialogue: 'Scouts have marked three approaches: river, ridge and forest. Each battlefield will answer differently to the ground beneath your boots.'
'Take the high ground where you can. A narrow ford is a fine place to hold a line, and a poor place to retreat.'

spots.name: Master Smith Rurik
spots.text: Rurik's arms are black with forge soot. He measures every blade as if it were a promise.
dialogue: 'Steel has a memory. Every temper leaves a little of the smith in it.'
'I can improve a weapon or armor to +15. I can also draw socketed runes without damaging them. Nothing is free but advice.'

spots.name: Furnace Broker
spots.text: A well-dressed broker waits beside a sealed crate of furnace fittings.
spots.companion_quest_text: The former employer offers Edda the workshop if she signs away the workers' claims. With the tool register and wage testimony in hand, she can reject the bargain, establish shared rules, or take ownership only with binding worker protections.

spots.name: Former Spearman
spots.text: A former soldier waits beside the hall's public notice board.
spots.companion_quest_text: The men confirm they were threatened with forfeited pay if they refused the recalled muster. Hear their account before deciding whether Anselm should testify, offer a lawful compact or refuse to rebuild the unit.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: What makes the soldiers' testimony credible?
options: Every account repeats the same exact phrase
Their separate pay records and leave marks corroborate the threat
The officer says the order was routine
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Their separate pay records and leave marks corroborate the threat
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: Independent records support the soldiers' accounts and establish a pattern of coercion.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A repeated phrase can be coached, and the officer's assertion is not evidence.

spots.name: The Two Witnesses
spots.text: Two villagers wait beneath the hall's public notice board; one describes an order, the other remembers soldiers acting without it.
spots.companion_quest_text: Escort both witnesses to safety without asking either to endorse Garrick's old decision. Their accounts conflict on whether the commander ordered the reprisals, but both deserve protection and an independent hearing.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which approach best protects the witnesses while preserving the reliability of their testimony?
options: Keep them together and rehearse one shared account
Escort them separately, record each account independently and preserve the differences
Choose the witness whose story supports Garrick's earlier decision
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Escort them separately, record each account independently and preserve the differences
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: Separate escorts and independent statements protect the witnesses without forcing their memories into a single story.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A rehearsed or selectively chosen account would compromise the hearing and place the witnesses at risk.

spots.name: Sergeant Voss
spots.text: Spears sharp, boots dry. Give the word and we march. Rear attacks and flanks win fights, captain. Remember it.

spots.name: The Returned Commander
spots.text: The accused commander waits under guard, with his sword surrendered and the hearing order on the table.
spots.companion_quest_text: The commander has surrendered after his remaining soldiers were offered safe conduct, and the witnesses are secure. Compare the written order with the independent accounts before deciding what Garrick should say at the hearing.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Signal Keeper's Assistant
spots.text: A cracked brass signal plate lies beneath the old watch notice.
spots.companion_quest_text: Lucan recognises the Orrowen signal code. Someone used the old flight pattern after the garrison was supposedly disbanded. He asks you to preserve the plate before the patrol clerk removes it.

spots.name: Convoy Survivor
spots.text: A survivor carries a splintered bolt recovered from the convoy road.
spots.companion_quest_text: Dorian recognises the fletching on the bolt. Compare its maker's mark with the convoy inventory to establish which shipment was attacked.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which clue reliably identifies the diverted convoy?
options: The maker's mark matched to the dated quartermaster inventory
The survivor's guess about the weather
A generic military stamp
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The maker's mark matched to the dated quartermaster inventory
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The maker's mark links the bolt to a specific issue batch in the convoy inventory.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Weather and a generic stamp cannot identify a particular shipment.

spots.name: The Messenger's Purse
spots.text: A courier carries a purse whose stitching Joss recognises from an old job.
spots.companion_quest_text: Joss admits the purse came from a payment he kept after helping a child escape. He recognises the broker's knot and asks you to follow the money without frightening the courier.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: A clean bed and a hot meal cost 20 gold. Your company can recover its nerve here.

spots.name: Retired Road Scout
spots.text: The scout keeps a folded route map beneath his cup.
spots.companion_quest_text: The scout remembers a patrol that moved without horses and avoided the main road. Lucan lays the signal timings beside the route notes.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The signal plate records a dusk flash, then a second flash from the western ridge. The patrol left no hoofprints. Which route best fits the evidence?
options: The west ridge footpath after dusk
The southern cart road at noon
The river ford before sunrise
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The west ridge footpath after dusk
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The timings and lack of hoofprints match a foot patrol on the west ridge. Lucan marks the route and identifies the deserters' likely passage.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: That route conflicts with either the signal timing or the missing hoofprints. Compare both clues before choosing.

spots.name: Roadside Fletcher
spots.text: A fletcher remembers repairing the same bolt pattern before the ambush.
spots.companion_quest_text: The fletcher's repair record and the road's impact marks allow Dorian to reconstruct the shot. Determine which trajectory matches the physical evidence.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which reconstruction fits the recovered evidence?
options: A shot from the raised western bank matching the impact angle
A shot fired straight down from the road
A bolt launched from inside the convoy wagon
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A shot from the raised western bank matching the impact angle
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The angle and recovered splinter pattern point to the raised western bank.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The other trajectories contradict the impact angle and wood damage.

spots.name: Cellar Ledger Broker
spots.text: A cellar broker has hidden a second account book behind the cask rack.
spots.companion_quest_text: The ledger lists debtors and displaced families as cargo. Joss asks you to identify the broker's coded entries before the book is moved.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which entry proves the ledger is selling identities rather than recording ordinary cargo?
options: A coded name matched to a debtor's sealed refuge receipt
A tally of empty wine casks
A list of routine inn-room charges
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A coded name matched to a debtor's sealed refuge receipt
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The matching code and sealed receipt show that a person's identity was being traded as leverage.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The other entries are ordinary trade records and do not identify a person being targeted.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The Weald's best bowyers and charm-sellers trade here. Use the party counter to compare and buy equipment.

spots.name: Former Garrison Clerk
spots.text: A former clerk asks for a private hearing before the market opens.
spots.companion_quest_text: The clerk confirms that the deserters carried the pay chest away, but also names a family who sheltered them under threat. Lucan asks you to hear the witness without turning their fear into another accusation.

spots.name: Quartermaster's Runner
spots.text: A runner has a duplicate tally of the missing convoy supplies.
spots.companion_quest_text: The duplicate tally shows that the quartermaster removed supplies before the ambush. Dorian must confront him with the record and decide whether to testify, make restitution or decline public absolution.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which record ties the quartermaster to the diversion?
options: A signed issue-and-return tally with a false return entry
An unsigned market rumour
A damaged wagon wheel
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A signed issue-and-return tally with a false return entry
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The signed tally records the quartermaster's custody and the false return.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The rumour and damaged wheel do not establish who diverted the supplies.

spots.name: The Refugee Cart
spots.text: A cart waits behind the market with frightened debtors hidden beneath canvas.
spots.companion_quest_text: The ledger's names match the people hiding in the cart. Get them to safety before the brokers return, then let Joss decide what restitution can be offered.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The brokers are approaching. Which escape plan protects the named debtors without exposing their identities?
options: Move the cart through the covered mill lane and leave the name list sealed
Read the names aloud to draw the brokers away
Split the group and send each debtor alone through the main gate
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Move the cart through the covered mill lane and leave the name list sealed
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The debtors reach shelter together and their identities remain protected.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: That plan exposes the debtors or separates them where the brokers can intercept them.

spots.name: Lucan Thorne
spots.text: A steady yeoman captain, once sworn to House Orrowen. He will travel with you if you can offer a place in the company.

spots.name: Joss Harrow
spots.text: A quick-handed smuggler who knows every back room between the coast and the March. He asks for 50 gold and a chance to choose his own risks.

spots.name: Tomas Wren
spots.text: A fearless young messenger who has outrun three patrols. He wants a company that will let him prove himself.

spots.name: Verra Nightsong
spots.text: A singer with a spy's memory and a diplomat's smile. She will only trust a company that has already earned Joss Harrow's confidence.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.
spots.companion_quest_text: Brisa recognises the old village register beneath the crier's notices. Several displaced families were erased when the temporary infirmary closed. She asks you to recover the ledger before its names are lost.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The herbwives keep a quiet room for weary travellers. Rest costs 20 gold.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The herbwives keep a quiet room for weary travellers. Rest costs 20 gold.
spots.companion_quest_text: The innkeeper remembers three families who sheltered in the upper rooms. Brisa compares their accounts with the recovered ledger. Their needs differ: one needs medicine, one needs a safe room, and one needs a way home.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Brisa lays out three testimonies. Mira needs a safe room, Pell needs medicine, and Oren's family cannot travel home without an escort. Which request is specifically a medical emergency?
options: Mira needs a safe room
Pell needs medicine
Oren needs an escort
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Pell needs medicine
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: You match Pell's fever notes to the infirmary ledger. Brisa can now assign a healer without exposing the other families.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: That testimony describes shelter or safe passage, not the urgent medical need. Read the three accounts again.

spots.name: Foundry Hand
spots.text: A soot-streaked worker warms both hands around a cup and watches the door.
spots.companion_quest_text: The foundry hand names the workers who paid for the missing tools through withheld wages. Edda listens to each account and separates verified claims from rumour. The workers want their names and wages recorded before anyone bargains over the furnace.

spots.name: Recovered Patient
spots.text: A patient remembers the date the ward changed its draught.
spots.companion_quest_text: Petra checks the patient's account against the surviving sample and the apothecary's dated batch notes. Verify which evidence confirms the treatment was diluted.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: What verifies the patient's account without relying on memory alone?
options: A matching batch note and a sealed sample analysis
A rumour repeated by another patient
The ward's painted sign
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A matching batch note and a sealed sample analysis
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dated batch note and sealed sample independently corroborate the patient's recollection.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A repeated rumour and a sign cannot verify the contents of a batch.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Foxglove trades in herbs, bows and travel gear. The quartermaster can arrange your equipment.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Foxglove trades in herbs, bows and travel gear. The quartermaster can arrange your equipment.
spots.companion_quest_text: The market factor offers a practical solution: a rotating care network, with supplies shared between households. Brisa asks you to choose how Foxglove will remember and care for its displaced families.

spots.name: Apothecary's Ledger Keeper
spots.text: A ledger keeper has kept a copy of the ward's medicine receipts.
spots.companion_quest_text: Petra finds a discrepancy between the ward's full-strength medicine charges and the diluted doses patients received. Identify the record that can establish the discrepancy.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which comparison is the strongest evidence of false billing?
options: The invoice quantities against the signed dispensing register
The colour of the medicine bottle
The ward's public donation board
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The invoice quantities against the signed dispensing register
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The signed dispensing register shows what was actually issued, allowing the invoices to be checked.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Bottle colour and donation totals do not establish the medicine dispensed.

spots.name: Old Brisa
spots.text: A village elder and healer. She asks no oath, only that the company protect the road folk.

spots.name: Edda Stonehand
spots.text: A blunt siege-wright from Brennhallow. She is searching for proof that the old tollhouse stores can supply a rebuilt workshop.

spots.name: Bram Cullen
spots.text: A gentle giant with a pit-fighter's scars. The camp must be cleared before he will risk joining another armed company.

spots.name: Foundry Tool Clerk
spots.text: A clerk keeps the foundry's tool register beneath a stack of unpaid invoices.
spots.companion_quest_text: Edda checks the old foundry register. Several specialist tools were charged to workers who never received them; others were loaned freely and must not be counted as theft. Compare the marks and identify what is truly missing.

spots.name: Debt Runner
spots.text: A frightened courier carries a transfer notice stamped by a private debt company.
spots.companion_quest_text: Bram Cullen recognises the jailer's mark on the transfer notice. His prison debt has been sold to a private company, along with claims against several other inmates. He asks you to trace the contract before the company can move them.

spots.name: Ward's Former Steward
spots.text: The former steward offers Petra the last page of the triage register.
spots.companion_quest_text: The triage register confirms that vulnerable patients were given priority only on paper. Petra must decide how to expose the error while protecting those who could be harmed by public disclosure.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which approach preserves accountability while minimising harm to patients?
options: Publish every patient's name
Destroy the register
Publish verified treatment records with patient identities redacted
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Publish verified treatment records with patient identities redacted
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: A redacted record preserves the evidence while protecting patients' identities.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Publishing names risks further harm; destroying the register removes the proof.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Carved Waystone
spots.text: A tiny hooked mark has been cut into the underside of the waystone.
spots.companion_quest_text: Kestrel spots a contract mark used by their former handlers. It points to a safehouse where names were traded for patrol routes. Kestrel asks you not to touch the mark until its pattern is copied.

spots.name: The Sealed Vessmoor Summons
spots.text: A House Vessmoor courier waits with a wax-sealed summons addressed to Isaure.
spots.companion_quest_text: The summons demands Isaure return and denounce the company. She recognises her relative's seal but notices the witness mark is missing.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The timber hall offers a dry bed and a warm fire for 20 gold.

spots.name: Safehouse Caretaker
spots.text: The caretaker's ledger has been scraped clean, but the pressure marks remain.
spots.companion_quest_text: Kestrel reconstructs the hidden entries from the paper grooves. The safehouse used three signs to warn its occupants.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The caretaker says the warning was never a spoken password. Which sign would tell a fugitive that watchers were waiting outside?
options: A lantern turned toward the street
A shutter left open on the upper floor
A bucket placed beside the rear step
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A lantern turned toward the street
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The lantern mark matches the hidden ledger notation. Kestrel finds the watcher schedule and the list of names sold to the patrol.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The caretaker shakes their head. That sign was ordinary household business, not the warning used by the handlers.

spots.name: Household Muster Clerk
spots.text: A former Vessmoor clerk keeps a copy of the household muster.
spots.companion_quest_text: The muster divides retainers between lawful household duty and private loyalty. Compare the orders with the seal register before deciding who was actually summoned.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which detail exposes the mentor's forged muster order?
options: The order uses a retired seal number absent from the current register
The parchment is folded twice
The retainers wear different colours
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The order uses a retired seal number absent from the current register
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The retired seal number proves the order was forged and that the retainers were misled.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Folds and clothing do not establish whether the household order was authorised.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Carpenters and hunters bring their wares to the square. The factor can open your company stores.

spots.name: Protected Witness
spots.text: A courier waits among the timber merchants, carrying a sealed statement.
spots.companion_quest_text: The witness can identify the handler who sold the names, but revealing them would expose the safehouse families. Kestrel asks you to protect the witness before deciding what the records should become.

spots.name: The Gatehouse Challenge
spots.text: A Vessmoor duelling witness carries the mentor's challenge and a copy of the original oath.
spots.companion_quest_text: Isaure's former mentor demands a duel to settle her perceived dishonour. The witness can confirm the forged order; choose a response that protects Isaure's agency and avoids turning the challenge into a blood feud.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which response answers the challenge while preserving a lawful path to resolution?
options: Present the original oath and forged muster before witnesses, then offer arbitration
Accept a duel to the death without hearing the evidence
Burn both documents and accuse the retainers
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Present the original oath and forged muster before witnesses, then offer arbitration
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The witnesses recognise the forged order. Isaure can face her mentor without accepting his false terms.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The other responses either risk needless death or destroy the evidence needed for a fair hearing.

spots.name: Kestrel
spots.text: A silent scout with an old contract to settle. A place among your outriders will do.

spots.name: Lady Isaure Vessmoor
spots.text: A proud heir stripped of her lands. She will speak after the Vessmoor gate is opened and the road is safe.

spots.name: Ser Willem Roake
spots.text: A disciplined duelist who accepts no commander lightly. He follows only after Lady Isaure has joined.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: The Challenge at Dawn
spots.text: A messenger brings Willem a sealed challenge from the rival he defeated years ago.
spots.companion_quest_text: Willem recognises the rival's seal. Hear the accusation in full before accepting the challenge; the squire named in the letter may be the key to what happened.

spots.name: The Unclaimed Brennhallow Seal
spots.text: A clerk has found fresh orders bearing the seal of a Brennhallow successor who has not appeared in public.
spots.companion_quest_text: Corwin recognises the family seal but not the impression's edge. Preserve the orders and compare the wax, date and issuing register before treating them as lawful commands.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which detail most strongly indicates that the orders were issued under a forged or unauthorised seal?
options: The wax is a dark red colour
The impression lacks the registered edge mark and cites an absent successor not listed in the household roll
The order is written in formal language
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The impression lacks the registered edge mark and cites an absent successor not listed in the household roll
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The missing registered edge and absent name show that the seal was used without verified authority.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Colour and formal wording do not authenticate a seal. Compare the impression and issuing register.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Red Mare charges 20 gold for a night's rest and a stable for your mounts.

spots.name: Witnesses to Honour
spots.text: Two former seconds disagree about the order of the old duel, while a retired clerk remembers a sealed amendment.
spots.companion_quest_text: Compare the seconds' testimony with the sealed record and the squire's account. A single witness cannot settle a disputed contest.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which evidence best establishes whether the duel's result was technically lawful but unfairly obtained?
options: The rival's accusation alone
The sealed amendment, both seconds' independent accounts and the squire's dated letter
Willem's memory of the final exchange
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The sealed amendment, both seconds' independent accounts and the squire's dated letter
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The independent accounts and dated record show the ruling was technically valid, while revealing why the rival accepted the disadvantage.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Memory or accusation alone cannot settle the record. Compare independent testimony with the sealed amendment and the squire's letter.

spots.name: The Charter Examiner
spots.text: A retired notary keeps a copy of the Brennhallow charter and its witness schedule.
spots.companion_quest_text: Audit the charter's witness names, dates and limits. A seal can authenticate a document's origin only when the issuing authority and succession conditions are also established.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: What is the strongest basis for determining whether the charter grants Corwin authority now?
options: The family seal appears on the oldest copy
The dated witness schedule, succession clause and independent household roll agree on the current authority
A retainer says Corwin has always been the most capable heir
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The dated witness schedule, succession clause and independent household roll agree on the current authority
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The matching records establish the charter's conditions and show that the disputed successor has no verified standing.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A seal or personal opinion cannot replace the charter's witness schedule and succession conditions.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The central market carries Vessmoor steel, tack and provisions. Visit the counter to manage your gear.

spots.name: The Unarmed Yard
spots.text: The rival waits beside the old practice yard. The squire has asked that the dispute not become another public spectacle.
spots.companion_quest_text: Resolve the challenge without demanding a fight to the death. A formal rematch, a public correction or a non-lethal sparring match where the rival may yield are all possible. Then choose Willem's lasting answer.

spots.name: The Hall of Retainers
spots.text: Brennhallow retainers have gathered to hear Corwin's position; several demand that the disputed orders be withdrawn.
spots.companion_quest_text: Hear the retainers separately and publish the limits of any interim arrangement. Corwin may submit the claim, renounce personal advantage or accept only temporary custody under independent review. No outcome grants him power to bind the Seven Houses.

spots.name: Anselm Pike
spots.text: A veteran sergeant with a dry wit and a gift for keeping recruits alive. He will join a disciplined company.

spots.name: Garrick Holt
spots.text: A defeated heavy-knight commander. Spare the Catacombs' guardian and prove that honour can outlive defeat.

spots.name: Lord Corwin Brennhallow
spots.text: The Regent's conflicted son. He will not leave the capital before the fourth act begins.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: The Sanctuary Bell
spots.text: The bell at the riverside sanctuary rings for families turned away after armed fugitives exploited its protection.
spots.companion_quest_text: Odalys must hear why the doors were closed before asking anyone to reopen them. The sanctuary's faith community is not the secret Covenant faction.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Ferry House offers a meal and a bed for 20 gold.

spots.name: The Rule of Shelter
spots.text: A keeper, two residents and a family waiting outside each describe a different fear.
spots.companion_quest_text: Hear the residents, keepers and threatened families separately. Draft rules that protect people seeking refuge while allowing credible threats to be handled through due process.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which temporary rule protects sanctuary without granting immunity for violence?
options: Admit families, separate immediate threats, investigate specific allegations fairly and never punish a household for another person's actions
Turn away every newcomer until the armed fugitives are found
Promise that anyone inside can never be questioned or held accountable
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Admit families, separate immediate threats, investigate specific allegations fairly and never punish a household for another person's actions
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The rule protects families, addresses immediate danger and preserves fair process for specific allegations.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Blanket exclusion abandons those in need; blanket immunity leaves others unsafe. Safeguards must do both jobs.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Ferry traders sell river gear and imported goods. The factor can access your party shop.

spots.name: At the Threshold
spots.text: The armed pursuers reach the sanctuary road. The families are ready to move, but the keepers refuse to abandon the infirm and the elderly.
spots.companion_quest_text: The pursuers arrive. Odalys can negotiate a surrender, organise an escorted evacuation or defend the perimeter while keeping a clear route for civilians. Choose the refuge's lasting path after the immediate danger is contained.

spots.name: Petra Quill
spots.text: A blunt field surgeon who left a noble household after refusing to abandon wounded levies.

spots.name: Sister Odalys
spots.text: A former inquisitor seeking atonement. She asks that the Kingsroad Catacombs be cleansed before she takes up arms again.

spots.name: Seraphine Tarnholt
spots.text: A healer-knight whose faith has survived too many failures. Her story begins in the fourth act.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: The Misbound Volume
spots.text: A library runner has found a catalogue entry that no longer matches the volume on its shelf.
spots.companion_quest_text: Orlan recognises a reference to a conscription-limit clause that has been removed from the public catalogue. Find the surviving volume and establish where it came from.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Garrison Inn provides a guarded room for 20 gold.

spots.name: The Marginal Hand
spots.text: A bookbinder remembers repairing the disputed volume and kept a rubbing of its damaged binding.
spots.companion_quest_text: Compare the handwriting, binding marks and duplicate copies. Provenance must be established from physical evidence, not from a convenient confession.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which combination best verifies that the annotation belongs to the original volume?
options: Matching ink alone, without checking the book
The same hand in a dated duplicate, matching binding marks and an unbroken catalogue trail
A custodian's claim that the note looks old
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The same hand in a dated duplicate, matching binding marks and an unbroken catalogue trail
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dated duplicate and matching binding marks establish a credible chain of provenance for the annotation.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A single visual impression or an unsupported claim cannot establish provenance. Compare independent physical records.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The mile market stocks practical arms and armour for the southern road.

spots.name: The Archive Custodian
spots.text: An archive custodian offers access to the sealed register, but asks Orlan to suppress a politically dangerous annotation.
spots.companion_quest_text: The annotation is verified. The custodian will permit access only if the record is handled responsibly; decide whether to publish, deposit independent copies or redact vulnerable names.

spots.name: Dorian Vask
spots.text: A pragmatic mercenary captain. He asks for a fair share and a clear chain of command.

spots.name: Orlan Pike
spots.text: An exiled fire scholar who waits for the Bell Under Leaves to fall silent before returning to the field.

spots.name: Ysolde Marrow
spots.text: A strategic ice mage and merchant's daughter. She joins after Verra's negotiations open the Ysmark route.

spots.name: Ilyan Voss
spots.text: A former tower guard turned battle mage. His loyalty is pledged to the later campaign, not a passing contract.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A rusted strongbox contains 120 gold and a map fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Rootbound Warden
spots.text: A former road captain has become the keeper of this den. He has chained the old tunnel doors and refuses to let the dead rest.

spots.name: The Containment Lattice
spots.text: Three rune sockets surround a cracked containment ring. The apparatus is dormant but unstable.
spots.companion_quest_text: Ilyan asks you to stabilise the lattice without completing the dangerous resonance. Use the page's safety notes to ground the active rune, isolate the feedback path and leave the final socket empty.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which sequence safely contains the lattice without triggering the unstable resonance?
options: Ground the active rune, isolate the feedback path and leave the final socket empty
Activate all three runes at once to equalise their power
Remove the grounding rune while the feedback path remains open
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Ground the active rune, isolate the feedback path and leave the final socket empty
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The lattice settles. The experiment is contained, and Ilyan records the safe shutdown procedure before anyone touches the apparatus again.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The lattice begins to hum. Ilyan stops the attempt before it can escalate and explains why grounding and isolation must come before any further action.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A votive coffer holds 120 gold and a silver woodland token. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Bell-Keeper
spots.text: The last keeper guards the bronze bell, convinced its toll is the only thing keeping a buried plague asleep.

spots.name: The Missing Tower Page
spots.text: A loose folio is wedged behind the bell mechanism, its edge marked with Ilyan's tower cipher.
spots.companion_quest_text: Ilyan recognises the folio as a page removed from the Silent Tower's rune-interaction record. Preserve the original sequence and its warning annotations; the missing page explains why the experiment was halted.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A sealed royal chest contains 120 gold and a signet fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Ashen Reeve
spots.text: A disgraced Vessmoor reeve commands the ossuary's looters, claiming the crown still owes his family a debt.

spots.name: The Apprentice's Signal
spots.text: A faint tapping answers from behind the sealed apparatus chamber.
spots.companion_quest_text: The apprentice is alive but frightened, and the apparatus is still drawing power. Reach them by negotiation, rescue or a careful shutdown; do not treat the apprentice as the enemy. The research must be secured without sacrificing a person to protect it.

spots.name: Captain Ilyra Venn
spots.text: The Assembly calls this a port. The sailors call it the last honest light before the black current. Three beacon crews vanished in one month.
dialogue: A sealed lighthouse ledger was carried into Tideglass Grotto before the last keeper disappeared.
Bring the ledger back intact. I will put the truth before the Assembly, even if it costs me my chair.

spots.name: Tidebound Factor
spots.text: Charts, rope, salt-proof mail and provisions. No one sails the outer shoals without a proper line.

spots.name: Maren Vey
spots.text: A quiet pilot who knows the reefs by the sound of water against stone. Maren will only sail with a company that brings the Tideglass ledger back.

spots.name: The Lantern & Keel
spots.text: A warm room above the tide stairs. The keeper serves fish stew and keeps a dry chart table.

spots.name: Maren's Chart Table
spots.text: Maren has marked a forgotten signal route in the margin of her chart. The last sounding may reveal why the Northstar crew vanished.

spots.name: The Borrowed Verse
spots.text: A dockside singer performs a familiar melody with unfamiliar words praising the Covenant.
spots.companion_quest_text: Verra recognises a song she wrote, but the verses have been altered to praise the Covenant. Find who supplied the new copy before the troupe is forced to perform again.

spots.name: The Salt Register
spots.text: A harbour clerk shows Ysolde a register whose family names change halfway through a past levy year.
spots.companion_quest_text: Find the original salt register and identify which entries were altered after the levy. Brinegate remains a Tidebound Assembly port; this record concerns families across the coast, not a claim to the city's sovereignty.

spots.name: The Missing Passenger Leaf
spots.text: A harbour archivist has kept a duplicate page from the Tideglass Ledger, hidden behind an outdated customs register.
spots.companion_quest_text: Maren recognises the ship's notation, but this page records passengers under temporary names and omits the cargo lien. Compare the date, seal and passenger marks with the restored Northstar log before accepting the harbour office's account.

spots.name: Net-mender Ossa
spots.text: The tide pools have gone quiet. Even the gulls avoid the northern rocks. My brother saw lanterns moving under the water.

spots.name: The Brackish Cup
spots.text: The keeper offers a dry bed and a bowl of hot shellfish broth.

spots.name: The Hidden Reef Marker
spots.text: Three old stone marks rise from the tide pools. Their positions form a route through the reef teeth, but only in the right order.

spots.name: Saltmere Reef Market
spots.text: A sheltered market where coastal traders exchange supplies and reef goods. Its stock depends on which route the company has opened.

spots.name: The Troupe's Copybook
spots.text: A travelling troupe keeps its song sheets locked in a damp instrument case.
spots.companion_quest_text: Compare the troupe's copy with Verra's remembered refrain. This text-based rhythm puzzle is accessible without audio.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The original refrain follows a repeated pattern. Which written cue sequence matches Verra's first version?
options: Lantern — river — lantern — home
Crown — sword — crown — throne
Ash — flame — ash — silence
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Lantern — river — lantern — home
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The repeated lantern cue and river return match Verra's original refrain. The altered copy inserts the Covenant's crown imagery.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Compare the repeated image and the returning final line; the other sequences do not match.

spots.name: Tide Marks
spots.text: Net-menders and record keepers bring tide tables, harbour marks and family testimony to a shared table.
spots.companion_quest_text: Reconcile the tide tables with harbour marks and family testimony. Separate deliberate name changes from ordinary clerical drift before making any identity public.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which set of evidence best verifies the altered family entries?
options: A single family's memory, without dates
Matching tide-table dates, harbour marks on the levy copies and independent family testimony
The harbour official's assurance that the register is correct
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Matching tide-table dates, harbour marks on the levy copies and independent family testimony
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dated tide tables and harbour marks align with independent testimony, confirming the pattern of altered names.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A single account or official assurance is not enough. Verify dates and marks against several families' testimony.

spots.name: The Families' Safe Passage
spots.text: A pilot and two displaced family members wait beside a tide-marked chart.
spots.companion_quest_text: The passenger leaf identifies families moved under false names. Interview them separately and plot a safe return route using the tide marks, pilot soundings and beacon record. Do not make a paid chart or a family's public testimony mandatory.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which route best protects the families while matching the verified tide and beacon evidence?
options: Use the western channel at the agreed slack tide, with a local pilot and a private landing
Send the families through the exposed eastern shoal at low water without a pilot
Publish their names and departure time before arranging passage
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Use the western channel at the agreed slack tide, with a local pilot and a private landing
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The soundings and beacon record agree on a sheltered landing. The families can travel without exposing their identities to the harbour brokers.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The exposed shoal or premature public disclosure would place the families at risk. Compare the tide marks with the pilot's sounding and protect their names.

spots.name: Beacon Apprentice
spots.text: The old signal lens was removed three nights before the beacon went dark. The official log says it was never there.

spots.name: Quay Provisioner
spots.text: Fresh rope, lamp oil and travel gear for the coast road.

spots.name: The Silent Signal Post
spots.text: A shuttered signal post faces the outer shoals. Its old bell can still carry a pattern across the water, if someone remembers the sequence.

spots.name: Neris Quell
spots.text: A young reef diver steps from the beacon storehouse. Neris Quell was forced to salvage for Blackwake, but she sabotaged their signal theft and knows the second beacon's hidden approach.

spots.name: Neris's Chart
spots.text: Neris has drawn a second route across the shoals, one that does not appear on any Tidebound map. She is ready to show you where the hidden beacon lies.

spots.name: The Public Stage
spots.text: The troupe is expected to perform the altered song at the quay gathering.
spots.companion_quest_text: The patron's agents are watching the stage. Verra can present the original, protect the performers or write a new response, but the troupe must be allowed to refuse.

spots.name: The Wharf Hearing
spots.text: A harbour official argues that restoring the names will unsettle trade. A ledger suggests the official profited from the old levy.
spots.companion_quest_text: Present the verified record at the wharf hearing. Negotiate phased disclosure, protect vulnerable families or expose the official's private profiteering. Let the families decide how their identities should be restored.

spots.name: Keeper's Strongbox
spots.text: Inside is a salt-stained chart and the missing lighthouse ledger. The last page bears the Seven Flames seal, deliberately scraped away.

spots.name: The Reef Warden
spots.text: A former beacon guard stands between you and the outer chamber. He has been ordered to keep the ledger buried, but his hands shake when he sees the seal.

spots.name: Captain's Logbook
spots.text: The captain's waterproof case holds the Northstar's final sounding: the crew saw a second signal burning beyond the reef before the ship was boarded.

spots.name: Blackwake Salvage Captain
spots.text: The salvage captain has stripped the wreck and kept its log as leverage. Maren recognizes the ship's brass compass on his belt.

spots.name: The Wreck's Cargo Lien
spots.text: A sealed cargo case remains trapped beneath the Northstar's broken deck.
spots.companion_quest_text: Compare the cargo marks with the passenger leaf and the recovered captain's log. The crew diverted the ship to evade a blockade, but the cargo owner later claimed the families' property as salvage. The evidence is complete; choose how to protect the survivors while restoring the truth.

spots.name: The Unread Oath
spots.text: A young initiate carries an oath sheet whose lines were covered before the ceremony.
spots.companion_quest_text: Seraphine recognises the chapter's seal, but the initiate was asked to swear before being allowed to read the text. Preserve the original sheet and record the recruit's account without pressuring them to withdraw their oath.

spots.name: Guest Hall Keeper
spots.text: The keeper offers beds to travellers and members who need a quiet place away from the chapter.

spots.name: The Quiet Chapter Records
spots.text: A former scribe keeps a duplicate register of the order's admission ceremonies.
spots.companion_quest_text: Compare the ceremony register with separate member testimony. Determine whether the unread oath was a single lapse or a repeated practice, and protect the names of members who fear expulsion.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which evidence best establishes that the unread oath was an institutional practice rather than one scribe's mistake?
options: A single unsigned complaint
Matching ceremony entries across several dates, corroborated by separate member accounts
The chapter leader's assurance that the practice was harmless
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Matching ceremony entries across several dates, corroborated by separate member accounts
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The repeated entries and independent accounts establish a pattern while protecting the identities of vulnerable members.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: One complaint or an unsupported assurance cannot establish whether the practice was repeated. Compare dated records with separate testimony.

spots.name: The Chapter's Hearing
spots.text: The chapter officers have gathered with members who were never shown the oath they signed.
spots.companion_quest_text: Present the verified records and let members speak without being forced to remain or leave. The order must distinguish informed consent from obedience. Keep the public Covenant compact separate from any secret organisation that borrows its name.

spots.name: Chapter Council Table
spots.text: The council table is reserved for the chapter's formal hearing.
